nodes.name: govulncheck.yaml
nodes.summary: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that runs `make verify-govulncheck` nightly on the main branch to detect Go vulnerabilities affecting the project.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-generated from cert-manager's shared makefile-modules repository; uses a pinned Go version resolved via `make print-go-version`.

nodes.name: make-self-upgrade.yaml
nodes.summary: Scheduled workflow that runs `make upgrade-klone` and `make generate`, commits any changes to a self-upgrade branch, and opens or updates a pull request with the result.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Octo STS token exchange for scoped credentials and inline github-script JavaScript to manage pull requests.

nodes.name: renovate.yaml
nodes.summary: Scheduled workflow running self-hosted Renovate against the repository using `.github/renovate.json5`, with Octo STS credentials, to keep dependencies up to date.
nodes.languageNotes: Configuration is supplied through Renovate environment variables and an external JSON5 config file.

nodes.name: scorecards.yml
nodes.summary: OpenSSF Scorecards supply-chain security workflow that analyzes the default branch and uploads SARIF results to GitHub code scanning.
nodes.languageNotes: Triggers on branch protection changes, a weekly schedule, and pushes to master, with least-privilege permissions.
